headline: Buyer of Nezha Automobile, Which Posted a Net Loss of 18.3 Billion Yuan, Revealed: Shanzi High-Tech Behind the Operation; Restructuring via "Taiyi Shenglian" with 3 Billion Yuan Total Funding Plan; State-Owned Assets in Yichun and Nanning Deeply Entangled
summary: A creditors' meeting in the bankruptcy restructuring of Nezha Automobile's parent, Hozon New Energy, was held online. Shanzi High-Tech is behind the restructuring investor, with a 3 billion yuan total funding plan.
why: Nezha Automobile is an electric vehicle maker whose parent Hozon New Energy is in bankruptcy restructuring. Creditors and investors are affected by how the restructuring is funded and who takes control.

original_headline: 净亏损183亿元的哪吒汽车接盘人曝光，山子高科背后操盘，借道“太乙圣莲”重整哪吒汽车，计划共提供30亿元资金，宜春、南宁多地国资深陷其中
